name: Farmhouse Style Furniture - Custom Furniture & Kitchen Cabinets | White Bear Lake
description: At our core, we have a simple mission: to create handcrafted furniture that is both desirable and affordable. We understand the frustration of searching endlessly for the perfect piece, only to find it either out of reach financially or needing more quality. That’s why we have made it our goal to redefine the concept of “affordable furniture” by offering timeless, unique, and durable pieces made from solid wood. Our commitment extends beyond simply providing furniture. We deeply care about our community and have identified a genuine need for high-quality furniture at an accessible price point. By doing so, we aim to bring the beauty and craftsmanship of our pieces to a broader audience within our community and beyond.

name: Farmville Wholesale Electric Supply Co., Inc.
description: Farmville Wholesale Electric was founded in 1972 by Lynwood G. Smith of Farmville, Virginia. Mr. Smith, widely known as "Linnie", and his two brothers had previously established a contracting and retail firm known as Smitty Brothers Electric Company, which they owned for over forty years following World War II.  It was always Mr. Smith's dream, however, to be involved in the electrical business at the wholesale level.  That dream was realized through his two sons with the formation of FWESCO in 1972.  Mr. Smith went home to the Lord on January 17th, 2004.  He is dearly missed by all who knew him.
